quotes.quote: RFQ Title Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 RFQ Number 20-01
Request for Quotations 20-01 Aggregate Hardware Buy

OGS is seeking competitive quotes from Contract holders of the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) for the Lots indicated below.
BASIS FOR AWARD Highest Total Financial Score meeting specified Technical Requirements and Mandatory Pass/Fail Requirements.
OGS is releasing this Request for Quotes (RFQ) for Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 (“RFQ 20-01”).

findings.title: Currency and Decimal Format for Monetary Values
findings.fact: All monetary values must be in U.S. Dollars with two decimal points.

quotes.quote: All monetary values shall be in U.S. Dollar amounts and will be two decimal points (for example: $1.12).

findings.title: Reseller Quotes Not Accepted
findings.fact: Quotes from resellers are not accepted, meaning only original manufacturers or authorized distributors can bid.
findings.business_implication: If your company is a reseller or plans to submit a quote on behalf of a manufacturer, you will be disqualified. Only original manufacturers or authorized distributors with a direct contract under the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract can participate.
findings.action_recommendation: Confirm that your company is an original manufacturer or an authorized distributor under the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 contract. If not, consider partnering with an eligible manufacturer or distributor to submit a bid, ensuring compliance with this requirement.

quotes.quote: Quotes from Resellers will not be accepted.

findings.title: Requirement for Lot 2 Award
findings.fact: Contractors must have an award for Lot 2 to bid on this RFQ, indicating a prerequisite for eligibility.
findings.business_implication: Only contractors who already hold an award under Lot 2 (Hardware) of the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract are eligible to bid. If you do not have this award, your submission will be rejected.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that your company has an active award for Lot 2 under the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 contract. If not, explore options to obtain such an award before the RFQ deadline, or consider teaming with an eligible contractor.

quotes.quote: Contractors must have an award for Lot 2 to bid on this RFQ.

findings.title: Disqualification for Nonconforming Conduct or Response
findings.fact: The City may disqualify any Contractor whose conduct and/or Response fails to conform to the requirements of the RFQ.
findings.business_implication: Any deviation from the RFQ requirements, whether in conduct or in the response itself, can lead to disqualification. This includes failure to follow submission instructions, altering documents, or providing incomplete information.
findings.action_recommendation: Thoroughly review all RFQ requirements and ensure your submission is fully compliant. Pay close attention to formatting, completeness, and adherence to all instructions. Avoid any actions that could be perceived as nonconforming.

quotes.quote: Disqualify any Contractor whose conduct and/or Response fails to conform to the requirements of the RFQ;

findings.title: Deadline for Contractor Questions and Comments
findings.fact: Contractor questions and comments for the Aggregate Hardware RFQ will only be accepted up to the specified due date and time, and only via email submission of Attachment B.
findings.business_implication: You have a limited window to submit questions and comments. Missing this deadline means you cannot seek clarification, which could lead to misunderstandings and non-compliant bids.
findings.action_recommendation: Mark the deadline for questions and comments (November 13, 2020, 5:00 PM EST) and submit any inquiries via email to OGS.sm.PS.AggregateBuy@ogs.ny.gov with the specified subject line. Prepare your questions early to ensure timely submission.

findings.title: Bid Validity Period
findings.fact: Quotes and pricing submitted in response to RFQ 20-01 must remain open and valid for at least 120 calendar days from the RFQ submission due date, unless extended by mutual consent.
findings.business_implication: Your bid must remain valid for at least 120 days, which means you cannot withdraw or change your pricing during that period. This could impact your ability to adjust to market changes.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure your pricing is sustainable for at least 120 days. Consider potential cost fluctuations and include contingencies. Be prepared to honor your bid for the full validity period.

quotes.quote:
Quotes and pricing submitted in response to  RFQ 20-01 must remain open and valid for at least one hundred-twenty 
(120) calendar days from the date that RFQ Submissions are due, unless the time for making an award is extended by 
mutual consent of OGS and the Contractor.  Contractors are encouraged to keep their bids open beyond the one 
hundred-twenty (120) day period due to the provisions in Section 7.23 - Replacement Contractor.

findings.title: SKU Price List Requirement Before Submission Due Date
findings.fact: All proposed SKUs for products offered must be on the Contractor's approved Manufacturer Umbrella Contract Price List prior to the RFQ Submission due date.
findings.business_implication: If any proposed SKU is not on the approved price list by the submission deadline, the bid may be disqualified or not proceed in evaluation. This could result in losing the opportunity to compete for the contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that all SKUs intended for the bid are already on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract Price List well before the submission deadline. If any SKUs are missing, submit a Contract Modification request promptly, indicating they are for this RFQ, and ensure approval is received before the due date.

quotes.quote:

findings.title: Evaluation Process Overview
findings.fact: The RFP outlines a three-stage evaluation process: Administrative Review, Technical Evaluation of Configuration Submission, and Financial Evaluation.
findings.business_implication: The bid must successfully pass each stage to be considered for award. Failure at any stage (e.g., incomplete administrative documents or technical non-compliance) will eliminate the bid from further consideration.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all required documents (Attachment A, Attachment D, Manufacturer Information Page) are fully completed and submitted in the original format without any alterations. Double-check that the technical configuration meets all specifications before submission.

quotes.quote: EVALUATION PROCESS.
The evaluation is a three-stage process set forth below:
5.1.1 STAGE 1 ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW
5.1.2 STAGE 2 TECHNICAL EVALUATION OF CONFIGURATION SUBMISSION
5.1.3 STAGE 3 FINANCIAL EVALUATION

findings.title: Evaluation Weighting and Scoring
findings.fact: The Technical Response is Pass/Fail, while the Financial Response is 100% of the evaluation score. The total financial score is based on lowest cost with points allocated as: Standard Configuration 50 points, Required Products (Warranty/Services 15 points, Components 30 points, Peripherals 5 points).
findings.business_implication: Since technical is only pass/fail, the award decision will be based solely on price. Therefore, offering the lowest total cost for the evaluated items is critical to winning. The pricing strategy must be aggressive to maximize the financial score.
findings.action_recommendation: Develop a competitive pricing strategy that undercuts competitors while ensuring all mandatory items are included. Focus on reducing costs for Standard Configuration and Required Products, as these carry the most points. Consider volume discounts or bundling to lower overall price.

quotes.quote:
The relative weights of each part of the Proposal are as follows: 
Technical Response (Attachment A – Technical Response, Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan, and 
Manufacturer Information Page): Pass/Fail    
   Financial Response : 100%  
Total Financial Score is based on lowest cost and the points are weighted as follows: 
• Standard Configuration - 50 points 
• Required Products  
o Warranty/Services - 15 points 
o Components - 30 points  
o Peripherals - 5 points

findings.title: Required Products Designated for Evaluation
findings.fact: The RFP designates specific Products as Required Products for evaluation purposes.
findings.business_implication: The pricing and availability of these designated Required Products will directly impact the financial score. They are mandatory to quote and will be evaluated, so they must be included in the bid and priced competitively.
findings.action_recommendation: Identify the Required Products for each Standard Configuration from Attachment A. Ensure they are included in the bid and that pricing is competitive. Verify that all Required Products are on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract Price List.

quotes.quote: For evaluation purposes, specific Products have been designated as Required Products.

findings.title: Mandatory Products for Quotation
findings.fact: The RFP specifies that certain products are mandatory for contractors to quote.
findings.business_implication: Failure to quote all mandatory products could lead to rejection of the bid. This ensures that the bid is complete and comparable across all bidders.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the list of mandatory products in the RFP and ensure that all are included in the bid. Double-check that all required fields in Attachment A and Attachment C are completed for these products.
